data.situation:
At eleven, Maya followed the others back to the service room. Beneath a poster, the invited speaker had laid out three pages. The first contained a resident's account of an inactive lifestyle: long hours at a desk and evenings spent on the sofa. The second introduced preventive healthcare, with a space for questions about routine health checks. The third was a noise diary from a nearby workshop. Its author described frequent exposure to loud noise from machinery during the working week. A separate diagram showed air moving in and out of the body. When we inhale, air enters; when we exhale, it leaves. A visitor asked about the arrows while Maya wrote a question about the local services on the page beneath the poster. SATURDAY TALK — 29 MAY, 11 A.M.
Our programme aims to promote healthy living and improve access to preventive healthcare. Bring questions about local services to the discussion table. The resident’s account and the workshop noise diary describe different experiences. The speaker will explain the arrows on the breathing diagram and take questions about the local services afterwards.

readingBlocks.en: At eleven, Maya followed the others back to the service room. Beneath a poster, the invited speaker had laid out three pages. The first contained a resident's account of an inactive lifestyle: long hours at a desk and evenings spent on the sofa. The second introduced preventive healthcare, with a space for questions about routine health checks. The third was a noise diary from a nearby workshop. Its author described frequent exposure to loud noise from machinery during the working week. A separate diagram showed air moving in and out of the body. When we inhale, air enters; when we exhale, it leaves. A visitor asked about the arrows while Maya wrote a question about the local services on the page beneath the poster.
readingBlocks.zh: 十一点，玛雅跟着其他人回到服务室。海报下面，受邀讲者摊开了三页纸。第一页是一位居民自述的缺乏活动的生活：长时间坐在桌前，晚上又坐在沙发上。第二页介绍预防保健，并留出了填写日常健康检查相关问题的位置。第三页是附近一家作坊的噪声日记，作者描述了工作日里经常接触响亮机器噪声的情况。另一张图画出了空气进出身体的动作。我们吸气时空气进入，呼气时空气离开。一位访客问起图上的箭头，玛雅则在海报下面那页纸上写下了关于本地服务的问题。

readingBlocks.en:
SATURDAY TALK — 29 MAY, 11 A.M.
Our programme aims to promote healthy living and improve access to preventive healthcare. Bring questions about local services to the discussion table. The resident’s account and the workshop noise diary describe different experiences. The speaker will explain the arrows on the breathing diagram and take questions about the local services afterwards.
readingBlocks.zh:
周六讲座——5月29日上午十一点
我们的活动旨在倡导健康生活，并让更多人获得预防保健服务。请把关于本地服务的问题带到讨论桌前。居民自述与作坊的噪声日记描述的是不同经历。讲者会说明呼吸图上的箭头，之后再回答关于本地服务的问题。

glossary.zh: 平时活动和运动较少的生活方式
glossary.note: an inactive lifestyle 表示日常身体活动较少的生活方式。
glossary.example: The first contained a resident's account of an inactive lifestyle: long hours at a desk and evenings spent on the sofa.
glossary.exampleZh: 第一页是一位居民对缺乏活动的生活的自述：长时间坐在桌前，晚上又坐在沙发上。

glossary.zh: 为预防健康问题而提供的保健服务
glossary.note: preventive healthcare 是预防保健；preventive 说明服务的预防目的。improve access to preventive healthcare 表示让人们更容易获得这类服务。
glossary.example: The second introduced preventive healthcare, with a space for questions about routine health checks.
glossary.exampleZh: 第二页介绍预防保健，并留出了填写日常健康检查相关问题的位置。

glossary.zh: 反复或频繁接触某种环境因素
glossary.note: frequent exposure to + 接触对象；本句对象为响亮的机器噪声，不是媒体曝光。
glossary.example: Its author described frequent exposure to loud noise from machinery during the working week.
glossary.exampleZh: 作者描述了工作日里经常接触响亮机器噪声的情况。

externalEvidence.label: Cambridge Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: adjective, often occurrence; not formal verb frequent

externalEvidence.label: Collins English Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: phrase example page + component definitions + word partners

glossary.note: inhale 本句是不及物动词，描述吸气动作；不涉及吸入药物。
glossary.example: When we inhale, air enters; when we exhale, it leaves.
glossary.exampleZh: 我们吸气时空气进入，呼气时空气离开。

glossary.note: exhale 本句是不及物动词，描述呼气动作。
glossary.example: When we inhale, air enters; when we exhale, it leaves.
glossary.exampleZh: 我们吸气时空气进入，呼气时空气离开。

glossary.zh: 倡导或促进健康生活方式
glossary.note: aim to promote表达目的，不宣称效果已证实。
glossary.example: Our programme aims to promote healthy living and improve access to preventive healthcare.
glossary.exampleZh: 我们的活动旨在倡导健康生活，并让更多人获得预防保健服务。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Introduce the first two pages and the programme’s aim.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 朋友刚到，不知道海报和前两页材料讲什么。介绍居民的生活自述、预防保健这一页，以及活动的目的。
